subject.title: feat(candidate): add MCP app embed token contract

question: Should Carapace publish this MCP Apps mapping as a candidate export before the intended Control UI and macOS webview consumers have demonstrated the contract in use?
rationale: The PR adds a new shared candidate surface rather than repairing an established contract; the repository policy requires preview-backed candidate selectors, while the proposed cross-consumer validation remains future intent rather than observed behavior.

options.title: Validate before publishing
options.body: Require a rendered preview specimen and real host-to-app evidence from at least one intended consumer before merging the candidate export.

options.title: Accept provisional candidate status
options.body: Merge it as an explicitly provisional candidate contract and take ownership of validating or revising it when the first host integrations land.

recommendation.title: Validate before publishing
recommendation.body: Require a rendered preview specimen and real host-to-app evidence from at least one intended consumer before merging the candidate export.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only repository member concretely connected to this candidate-contract proposal in the available evidence.
